title: fix(deps): raise js-yaml floor to ^5.4.1 for GHSA-r3ph-w7gj-g6xm
body:
Fixes #20705

Clause-②: no

## Summary

`Validate Package Dependencies` (OSV-Scanner against `pnpm-lock.yaml`) flags `js-yaml@5.2.3` with GHSA-r3ph-w7gj-g6xm (5.3, fixed in 5.4.1). `@objectstack/metadata` is the only importer of `js-yaml`, so this PR raises its declared floor from `^5.2.3` to `^5.4.1` and takes the fix. It is the take-the-fix path `osv-scanner.toml` describes: the ledger keeps zero exemptions and is not touched, and neither is `.github/workflows/validate-deps.yml`.

## Files

- `packages/metadata/package.json`: `js-yaml` `^5.2.3` to `^5.4.1`.
- `pnpm-lock.yaml`: regenerated with a plain `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline` (pnpm 10.31.0, the `packageManager` pin), not edited by hand.
- `.changeset/js-yaml-5-4-1-osv-2026-09-29.md`: one `patch` for `@objectstack/metadata`, `Clause-②: no`.

## Lockfile diff

6 insertions, 6 deletions, three hunks: the metadata importer's `js-yaml` specifier (`^5.2.3` to `^5.4.1`) and version (`5.2.3` to `5.4.2`), and the `js-yaml` package and snapshot entries (`js-yaml@5.2.3` to `js-yaml@5.4.2`; its one dependency `argparse@2.0.1` is unchanged). Nothing else moves.

## Other js-yaml importers

None. `git grep` over every `package.json` finds `js-yaml` only in `packages/metadata` (plus `@types/js-yaml` `^4.0.9` as its devDependency, not a runtime copy). The lockfile had exactly one `js-yaml` version (5.2.3) and now has exactly one (5.4.2); there are no transitive copies and no `js-yaml` override in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`.

## What I ran

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `npm view js-yaml@5.4.1 version` | 5.4.1 |
| OSV-Scanner v2.3.8 (release SHA-256 verified), `scan --offline-vulnerabilities --lockfile=pnpm-lock.yaml` on `origin/main`'s lockfile (control) | exit 1, GHSA-r3ph-w7gj-g6xm on `js-yaml` 5.2.3 |
| The same scan on this branch | exit 0, `No issues found` (1369 packages) |
| `@objectstack/metadata` build (with its dependency closure), typecheck | pass |
| `@objectstack/metadata` test | 55 files, 828 tests pass |
| `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, every derived command run, then `--ran` | 62 derived, 58 pass, 4 NOT MEASURED |

The 4 NOT MEASURED gates are `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`. Each exited 3 (prerequisite not met): they sweep the whole workspace's `dist/`, which a full `pnpm build` would supply, and this diff changes no source. CI runs them.

## Changeset

A `patch` for `@objectstack/metadata` with `Clause-②: no`. The only published change is a dependency-range floor; no exported symbol, option key or accept/reject verdict moves.
